<h2 title="Class RefreshRouteOptions" class="title">Class RefreshRouteOptions</h2>
</div>
<div class="contentContainer">
<ul class="inheritance">
<li>java.lang.Object</li>
<li>

<div class="description">
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">RefreshRouteOptions</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>The options to specify how to refresh an already calculated route identified by a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routehandle" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>RouteHandle</code></a>. All the
 options that may result in a new route shape are ignored as no new route is calculated. Instead, only the data that
 accompanies a route, such as traffic information, can be refreshed. Therefore, the following route options are ignored:
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#alternatives"><code>RouteOptions.alternatives</code></a>, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#arrivalTime"><code>RouteOptions.arrivalTime</code></a>, and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeoptions#optimizationMode"><code>RouteOptions.optimizationMode</code></a>.
 If new <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-avoidanceoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>AvoidanceOptions</code></a> are specified, they are ignored as well and instead new <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sectionnotice" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>SectionNotice</code></a>'s
 are generated that indicate where the requested <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-avoidanceoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>AvoidanceOptions</code></a> are violated. Note that when
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-evcaroptions#ensureReachability"><code>EVCarOptions.ensureReachability</code></a> is set to true, the route refresh request will fail as this option
 is incompatible with a fixed route shape.
 If any of the ignored options are important, consider calculating a new route instead.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
